subject: [PATCH v2 3/4] fs/proc/task_mmu: don't read young/dirty from a non-present PMD in smaps

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau (Meta)
reviews.summary: Suggested reading the PMD only once with pmdp_get() in a separate patch before this one, to improve code cleanliness and reduce dereferences.

2026-11-16.patch_summary: This patch addresses a bug in the smaps_pmd_entry() function where it incorrectly reads young and dirty bits from non-present PMDs, leading to incorrect accounting of memory usage. The fix involves only reading these bits when the PMD is present.
